name: Gold Dust
overview: Scripture uses the imagery of gold dust to illustrate both the abundance and the divine ownership of precious resources. Job describes gold as being so plentiful it can be laid up like dust, emphasizing the richness bestowed by God. The presence of gold dust in the earth's depths highlights God's provision hidden within creation. Yet, Isaiah reminds us that true glory comes not from material wealth but from the Lord's rising light, while Haggai affirms that all silver and gold ultimately belong to the LORD of hosts, underscoring His sovereign authority over all riches.
